target: Audit, repair, and optimize the active root GitHub Actions workflow set without weakening required CI, trust boundaries, or fail-closed gates.
invariants: Runtime workflow behavior and live GitHub Actions results outrank documentation claims.
Required PR gates remain fail-closed and current to the PR head.
External AI, Docker Scout, and credential-dependent lanes must not poison core CI when unconfigured.
Existing issue labels must not be replaced by AI triage output.
Workflow actions that exercise security authority must be pinned or explicitly tracked as residual risk.
No application runtime code is modified.

commit.message: ci: harden and optimize GitHub Actions workflows
verify: Docker Scout credential and fallback behavior
Claude security-review credential and trusted-PR gates

pr.title: chore(ci): harden and optimize GitHub Actions workflows
pr.body: PR #1100 contains the bounded workflow hardening set and its evidence bundle.

steps.task: Enumerate every active root workflow and inspect triggers, permissions, actions, secrets, concurrency, summaries, and recent live failures.
requirements: Preserve contradictions and mark unknown branch-protection or secret state explicitly.
validation: All 17 pre-existing active root workflows are classified.

steps.task: Repair evidence-backed workflow defects and reduce redundant or misleading lanes.
requirements: Do not weaken required test, audit-validator, routing, or red-lane gates.
Do not make external LLM credentials a prerequisite for core CI.
commands: Update bounded workflow allowlist through GitHub contents API
validation: Docker Scout does not attempt empty authentication.
Security summaries distinguish skipped scans from completed scans.
Complete CI summary uses actual dependency results.
Duplicate Claude and docs jobs are removed from Complete CI.

steps.task: Validate the complete workflow set and bind results to the exact workflow-code head.
requirements: Record live run IDs, conclusions, residual risks, and skipped external audit status truthfully.
validation: Actionlint succeeds on all active workflows.
CodeQL succeeds on the pinned v4 action.
PR remains draft because workflow files are red-lane and independent embedded audit is unavailable.
